basic_details.job_title: SAIL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Advisor / Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL), Bhilai Steel Plant (BSP) has invited applications from ex-executives who have superannuated from SAIL for engagement as Advisor/Consultant for the HR – Canteen Services Department at BSP, Bhilai. Eligible and interested candidates would be required to submit their applications in soft copy through e-mail at [email protected] or by post addressed to GM (HR-Executive Establishment), Room No-210, 2nd Floor, Ispat Bhavan, Bhilai, Durg, Chhattisgarh latest by 10/11/2026.

qualification.details: Department: HR - Canteen Services. Grade E3 to E6. Age Limit: The upper age limit for engagement under these guidelines will be 65 years. Relevant date for this purpose will be date of issuance of offer for engagement/extension. Performance: The candidate should have no 'C' grading during last three years of service with SAIL before superannuation. Physical & Mental Fitness: The ex-executive should be fit to perform the duties assigned and submit a medical certificate in this regard along with the application. Effectiveness & Integrity: He/She should have good service record without any ongoing disciplinary/vigilance proceedings at the time of engagement/extension.

selection_process: The interested ex-executives may submit their application indicating their details
experience regarding their suitability for the position. The short listed candidates shall be called for an interview.

content_sections.heading: About SAIL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Bhilai Steel Plant (BSP) is a flagship unit of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL). This recruitment drive engages experienced ex-executives who have superannuated from SAIL to serve as Advisor/Consultant for the HR – Canteen Services Department at BSP, Bhilai, supporting operations across plant canteens and welfare activities.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates would be required to submit their applications in soft copy through e-mail at [email protected] or by post addressed to GM (HR-Executive Establishment), Room No-210, 2nd Floor, Ispat Bhavan, Bhilai, Durg, Chhattisgarh latest by 10/11/2026. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Department: HR - Canteen Services. Grade E3 to E6. Age Limit: The upper age limit for engagement under these guidelines will be 65 years. Relevant date for this purpose will be date of issuance of offer for engagement/extension. Performance: The candidate should have no 'C' grading during last three years of service with SAIL before superannuation. Physical & Mental Fitness: The ex-executive should be fit to perform the duties assigned and submit a medical certificate in this regard along with the application. Effectiveness & Integrity: He/She should have good service record without any ongoing disciplinary/vigilance proceedings at the time of engagement/extension.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Knowledge on matters related to quality, hygiene, and statutory compliance in the operation of all 50 canteens within the plant premises, in accordance with applicable statutory requirements. Should possess knowledge related to: 1. Food Safety. 2. HR - Welfare Activities. Any other assignment given by the Head of HR (Works) from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The interested ex-executives may submit their application indicating their details, experience regarding their suitability for the position. The short listed candidates shall be called for an interview.

content_sections.heading: Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial tenure of engagement will be six (6) months which can be extended further for a period of six (6) months.
